content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Let's examine what each option offers. Stripe provides a payment gateway with a user-friendly interface, but it's only available in 46 countries. PayPal offers a broader reach, but its account suspension policies are notoriously strict, and a suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad is a digital storefront builder, but it's also subject to platform restrictions, and its payment processing fees can be high. Lemon Squeezy is another digital storefront builder, but it's not available in many countries, and its payment processing fees can be steep. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce stack, complete with a user-friendly interface, automatic crypto payment verification, and full data ownership. This means you can sell digital art without relying on Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to handling restricted countries, each option has its own approach. Stripe and PayPal have strict country restrictions, and they're not available in many countries. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have country restrictions, and they're not available in all countries. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that's available in all countries, regardless of their economic or financial status. This means you can sell digital art without worrying about platform restrictions or country exclusions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, each option has its own advantages and disadvantages. Stripe and PayPal offer fast payment processing, but their fees can be high, and their real costs can add up quickly. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer competitive payment processing fees, but their real costs can be high due to their payment processing fees. In contrast, COREMERCH offers fast payment processing with low fees, and its real costs are transparent and predictable. This means you can sell digital art without breaking the bank.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer more automation features, but their ownership policies can be unclear. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full ownership of your data, and its automation features are robust and reliable. This means you can sell digital art without sacrificing ownership or control.

If you're looking for a user-friendly interface and fast payment processing, COREMERCH might be the best choice.
